meaning:
1) band, bond
2) house of bonds, prison (figurative)
Aramaic equivalent: e.sur (אֱסוּר "bond" H0613)

elsewhere.note: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax…
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will…
The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.
